# ---
# why: This file cites each eMudhra policy fixture.
# uses: cargo test
# how: cargo test reads the fixtures named in this file.
# ---
#
# The check date is 2026-10-24.
# A binary fixture has no comment.
# This file cites that fixture.
#
# The eight eMudhra intermediates and the eight Sectigo cross-signs come from impacted-intermediates.json.
# URL: https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/impacted-intermediates.json
# proof.zip on that site has the same eight eMudhra certificates.
# URL: https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/proof.zip
# Each proof signature verifies the message in proof/message.txt.
# The message text is We have a problem here - Wayne.
# Bugzilla attachment 9664066 has the same eight certificates and the same signatures.
# URL: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/attachment.cgi?id=9664066
# Bugzilla attachment 9664067 has the eight Sectigo cross-signs.
# URL: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/attachment.cgi?id=9664067
# Bug 2083449 records the same sixteen certificate hashes.
# URL: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2083449
# The cvebrief note records the same SPKI hashes.
# URL: https://cvebrief.com/deep-dives/emudhra-intermediate-ca-compromise/
# crt.sh hash lookup returned HTTP 502 on 2026-10-24.
# The certificate bytes were checked against the JSON file and the Bugzilla attachments.
# EM DV TLS CA - G2A was downloaded from crt.sh certificate 18286207181.
# URL: https://crt.sh/?d=18286207181
#
# intermediates/ holds DER, PEM, base64, gzip, and zip for each eMudhra certificate.
# sectigo/ holds DER and PEM for each cross-sign.
# The SPKI matches the eMudhra certificate.
# The certificate hash does not match.
#
# malleable/em-dv-tls-g3b-high-s.der is the eMudhra EM DV TLS CA - G3B certificate.
# The ECDSA s value is replaced by n minus s.
# The SPKI bytes stay the same.
# The certificate hash changes.
#
# leaves/example-test-ov-tls-g3c.pem is a test-only leaf.
# The subject is example.test.
# The signer is the recovered EM OV TLS CA - G3C key.
# The public scalar is 4.
# leaves/example-test-ov-cs-g3b.pem is a test-only leaf.
# The signer is the recovered EM OV CS CA - G3B key.
# The public scalar is 66.
# The matching chain file adds the real intermediate.
#
# roots/ comes from roots.json.
# URL: https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/roots.json
#
# bundles/cacert-2026-09-25.pem is the curl CA bundle from 2026-09-25.
# URL: https://curl.se/ca/cacert-2026-09-25.pem
# That file still holds emSign ECC Root CA - G3.
# bundles/cacert-2026-10-20.pem is the curl CA bundle from 2026-10-20.
# URL: https://curl.se/ca/cacert-2026-10-20.pem
# That file does not hold emSign ECC Root CA - G3.
# The bundle bytes are unchanged.
#
# negative/emsign-root-ca-g1.pem comes from the 2026-09-25 bundle.
# negative/emsign-root-ca-c1.pem comes from the 2026-09-25 bundle.
# negative/emsign-ecc-root-ca-c3.pem comes from the 2026-09-25 bundle.
# negative/em-dv-tls-g2a.pem is EM DV TLS CA - G2A from crt.sh.
# negative/emsign-root-tls-ca-g1.pem comes from Bugzilla attachment 9664144.
# negative/emsign-root-tls-ca-g1-cross.pem comes from Bugzilla attachment 9664144.
#
# chains/ is a byte copy of chains.zip from the incident site.
# URL: https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/chains.zip
#
# corelight/emudhra-1.pcap is testing/Traces/emudhra-1.pcap from the Corelight package.
# URL: https://github.com/corelight/emudhra-weak-keys
# The pcap holds the zeek-testing leaf and EM OV TLS CA - G3C.
# corelight/zeek-testing-*.pem files are the public server certificates from that package.
# corelight/emsign-root-tls-g3-cross-signed.pem is the public cross-signed TLS root.
# No private key from that package is in this directory.
#
